verses.restored: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and to thee shall the vow be performed.

familiar.text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

modern.text: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם נֶֽדֶר

verses.restored: O thou that hearest prayer, to thee shall all flesh come.

familiar.text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

modern.text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.

original.text: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כָּל בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ

verses.restored: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

familiar.text: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

modern.text: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.

original.text: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם

verses.restored: Blessed is the one you choose and bring near to dwell in your courts; we are satisfied with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

familiar.text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

modern.text: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

original.text: אַשְׁרֵ֤י תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ

verses.restored: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

familiar.text: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

modern.text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.

original.text: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל קַצְוֵי אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים

verses.restored: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

familiar.text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

modern.text: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.

verses.restored: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

familiar.text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

modern.text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.

original.text: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים

verses.restored: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

familiar.text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

modern.text: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.

original.text: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין

verses.restored: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

familiar.text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

modern.text: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

original.text: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ

verses.restored: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

familiar.text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

modern.text: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.

original.text: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ

verses.restored: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

familiar.text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

modern.text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.

original.text: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

familiar.text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

modern.text: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.

original.text: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה

verses.restored: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

familiar.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

modern.text: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.

original.text: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף יָשִֽׁירוּ
